name: Guerrilla
source: Pathfinder NPC Core, Guerrilla (pg. 95), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterTemplates.aspx?ID=37
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder NPC Core is ORC licensed material.
rules: For a military NPC or troop, or a mercenary. Stealth at the high skill value for its level; Athletics -2 if it has it; Strike damage -2; Sneak Attack and Pounce.

abilities.name: Sneak Attack
abilities.description: {Name} deals 1d6 extra precision damage to off-guard creatures.

abilities.name: Pounce
abilities.description: {Name} Strides and makes a Strike at the end of that movement. If {name} began this action hidden, they remain hidden until after this ability's Strike.
